Pacific Douglas is the Paragon (MLS) name for the neighbourhood the City of Surrey simply calls Douglas. The City describes it as "Surrey's most southern urban neighbourhood". It sits right on the US border, between the Peace Arch crossing on Highway 99 and the Pacific crossing on Highway 15. It is mostly residential, with an elementary school, a neighbourhood park and two small commercial nodes. Land use here is now guided by the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan, not the older Douglas neighbourhood plan.
Local Guide · Douglas & Border Crossing Pocket

Douglas is a small, tucked-away pocket. To the west is Peace Arch Provincial Park. To the north are Agricultural Land Reserve land and the woodland garden at The Glades. To the south is the border. Because it sits between two highways and two crossings, getting onto Highway 99 or Highway 15 is quick, while the streets inside stay residential.

blocks.text: Boundaries Hwy 99 to Hwy 15 · North of US Border

parts.t: The City describes Douglas as east of Highway 99, west of Highway 15 (176 Street) and north of the United States border, with the ALR and The Glades garden park on its north edge.

blocks.text: The name MLS® "Pacific Douglas" vs. City "Douglas"

parts.t: "Pacific Douglas" is the Paragon sub-area name. The City uses "Douglas", and the matching City planning area was the Douglas Neighbourhood Concept Plan. That plan's land-use designations have since been superseded, and the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan now guides land use here.

blocks.text: Roads and getting around Hwy 99, Hwy 15, 8 Ave & White Rock Centre

parts.t: Highway 99 and the Peace Arch crossing form the west edge, and Highway 15 and the Pacific crossing form the east edge. 8 Avenue and 0 Avenue run through the border area, and 16 Avenue (North Bluff Road) is the main east–west road to the north. No TransLink route through Douglas itself was confirmed. The nearest exchange is White Rock Centre, served by routes 321, 345, 351 and 375.

Douglas Elementary, at 17325 2 Avenue, is inside the neighbourhood. For secondary school, the nearby South Surrey schools include Earl Marriott Secondary (15751 16 Avenue) and Elgin Park Secondary (13484 24 Avenue). Catchment depends on the address, so check the Surrey Schools School Locator. On the Surrey Schools boundary map, Douglas is in the Douglas Elementary and Earl Marriott Secondary catchments.

blocks.text: Parks and recreation Dufferin Park & Peace Arch Provincial Park

parts.t: Douglas has its own neighbourhood park, Dufferin Park, at 17355 2 Avenue. It sits between 2 and 3 Avenue, west of 174 Street, and has a grass soccer field, a sports court, a playground and a parking lot off 2 Avenue. It's named for Dufferin Road, the old name for 2 Avenue. Peace Arch Provincial Park, at the Highway 99 crossing, has picnic areas, washrooms and gardens. For pools and programs, families use the South Surrey Recreation & Arts Centre on 20 Avenue, and the Semiahmoo and Ocean Park branches of Surrey Libraries.

blocks.text: Housing and zoning Residential lots & multi-unit rules

parts.t: Most homes in Douglas are residential lots. As in the rest of Surrey, each property has a zone under Surrey Zoning Bylaw 12000, which you can check in the City's COSMOS map. Surrey's small-scale multi-unit housing zones are RA, R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R5-S and R6. Under those rules, lots under 280 m² can usually have up to 3 units and larger lots up to 4. Eligible lots within 400 m of a frequent bus stop can have up to 6. Because no frequent bus route runs through Douglas, the 6-unit option is unlikely to apply, but check COSMOS for each lot. The City also reviews servicing capacity at the application stage. If you want land to build on, my
page covers what to check on a vacant lot.

blocks.text: Duplexes: strata or not? Strata plan vs. party-wall agreement

parts.t: A duplex can be held under one title with no strata corporation, or split into two strata lots under a strata plan filed at the Land Title Office. A strata duplex comes with a strata corporation, bylaws and Form B paperwork. A non-strata duplex usually relies on a party-wall agreement registered on title. Ask to see those documents early. Which plan guides land use in Douglas?
The Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan. The older Douglas neighbourhood plan's designations have been superseded.
Which elementary school is in Douglas?
Douglas Elementary at 17325 2 Avenue. Check the School Locator for the catchment of a specific address. The boundary map shows Douglas Elementary and Earl Marriott Secondary.
How do residents get to transit?
No bus route through Douglas itself was confirmed. The nearest exchange is White Rock Centre, with routes 321, 345, 351 and 375.
Highway 99 and the Peace Arch crossing to the west, Highway 15 and the Pacific crossing to the east, the US border to the south, and ALR land and The Glades to the north.
It can be near the north edge. Check the specific lot with the Agricultural Land Commission's map finder.
What's the difference between a strata and a non-strata duplex?
A strata duplex is split into two strata lots with a strata corporation. A non-strata duplex sits on one title with no strata corporation.
